workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the time slots where both are free (30-min meeting):

- Mon: 09:00 or 09:30
- Tue: 10:30, 13:00, or 13:30
- Wed: 15:00 or 15:30
- Thu: 10:00 or 16:30
- Fri: 11:00 or 11:30, 14:00, or 16:00

Please read Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots (or any other slots) work for them both.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against your slots. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots you listed work for both Elena and David - they each have conflicts at every one of those times.

However, I've identified the slots where BOTH Elena and David are free for a 30-minute meeting:

- Mon: 11:00 or 11:30
- Tue: 09:00 or 09:30
- Wed: 13:00 or 13:30
- Thu: 09:30, 14:30, or 15:00
- Fri: 15:00 or 15:30

Could you check Priya and Marcus's calendars to see if they are free during any of these times? We need to find an overlap where all four can attend.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've carefully cross-referenced the calendars. Unfortunately, there is NO 30-minute slot where all four partners are free.

Here are the mutual free times for Priya and Marcus:
- Mon: 09:00-10:00
- Tue: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wed: 15:00-16:00
- Thu: 10:00-10:30
- Fri: 11:00-12:00

And you listed Elena and David's mutual free times as:
- Mon: 11:00-12:00
- Tue: 09:00-10:00
- Wed: 13:00-14:00
- Thu: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Fri: 15:00-16:00

There is zero overlap between these two sets. The meeting cannot be scheduled next week with all four partners.

I will report this as infeasible.

infeasible.reason: After checking all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute time slot next week (Mon Nov 16 - Fri Nov 20, 9:00-17:00) where all four partners are simultaneously free. Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's mutual free times do not overlap with Elena Soto and David Okafor's mutual free times at any point during the week.
